meta.verdict_plain: Failed: 51% of homes dark at the worst hour (hour 250)
meta.cause_summary: h43: demand surge to 39,867 MW -> h78: 3 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 2 h (low -6 C)), rising to 6 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 7 h (low -8 C)) by h83 -> h84: 1.2 GW of units failed to start in the cold, rising to 3.2 GW of units failed to start in the cold by h95 -> h88: Lubbock below -5 C for 12 h (low -9 C) -> h91: reserves below 2,300 MW (1,933 MW) -> h95: rotating outages begin (2,000 MW) -> h97: under-frequency relays shed 5% at 59.3 Hz -> h97: gas wells freezing (basin temp -5 C): production -10% -> h99: shedding cut power to gas facilities: -0.7 GW gas fuel -> h101: 3 GW of gas plants without fuel, rising to 15 GW of gas plants without fuel by h211 -> survived with rotating outages (peak 16,300 MW)
